item: The drain's catch-up reads only followed pages, backs off failing ones and survives one page's store failing
status: shipped (fixture-verified; awaiting the operator's 72 h run)
summary: Opus review of #1269's drain: the backlog read is now one indexed EXISTS per followed page (it scanned the whole feed's changes every 30 s), a page checked or attempted in the last 5 minutes is left alone, backlog pages are not counted as deferred again each drain, and a page whose store raises is rolled back in a savepoint and named instead of ending the pass and heading the next one.
